items.stem: A prompt gives a good answer once but inconsistent answers on later runs. What is the best first fix?

options.text: Add explicit constraints and few-shot examples
options.rationale: Correct: constraints and examples anchor the model, reducing run-to-run variance.

options.text: Delete all instructions and keep it short
options.rationale: Removing structure usually increases variability, not consistency.
The input channel does not address output consistency.

options.text: Ask the same prompt louder in capitals
options.rationale: Formatting emphasis does not stabilise sampling variability.

items.stem: In a very long conversation the model starts ignoring an early requirement. What is the most likely cause?

options.text: Key context has fallen outside the effective context window
options.rationale: Correct: as a conversation grows, earlier content can be truncated or deprioritised, so the requirement must be restated or summarised.

options.text: The model has permanently forgotten how to follow rules
options.rationale: The model has not lost capability; the specific context is just no longer salient.
Tier does not change mid-conversation and is unrelated to this behaviour.
Examples help steer output and are not the cause of context loss.

items.explanation: Correct: as a conversation grows, earlier content can be truncated or deprioritised, so the requirement must be restated or summarised.

items.stem: Which TWO techniques help keep an important fact in play during a long task? (Select TWO)

options.text: Periodically summarise and restate the key fact
options.rationale: Correct: a running summary keeps essential context salient.

options.text: Store it in persistent instructions or memory
options.rationale: Correct: persistent instructions reintroduce the fact on every turn.

options.text: Hope the model keeps it in mind
options.rationale: Relying on chance is not a control.

options.text: Make the conversation as long as possible
options.rationale: Longer conversations increase the chance the fact is pushed out of context.

items.explanation: Correct: a running summary keeps essential context salient.
